summary: Safe Bulkers, Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing recapitulation agreements for four Japanese newbuild dry-bulk vessels (three 82,000 dwt Kamsarmax, one 182,000 dwt Capesize). Acquisitions will be financed via cash reserves (Kamsarmax) and a ten-year finance lease (Capesize) with purchase options after five years. Deliveries are scheduled between H1 2029 and H2 2029. This is an ordinary-course capital expenditure for fleet renewal, not a special situation. No tender offer, activist involvement, spin-off, or other event-driven category applies. The market should monitor delivery dates and financing commitments as standard operational updates.
